name: AxG AI Site Assistant
author: mathiasax

sections.description:
AxG AI Site Assistant transforms your website with an intelligent, 24/7 AI-powered floating assistant. Trained on your specific website content, products, and services, it instantly answers customer questions, guides visitors, and drives higher conversions.

Whether you run an e-commerce shop, a service business, or a corporate blog, AxG AI acts as your dedicated digital sales representative and support agent around the clock.

Key Features

  • 24/7 Intelligent Support: Answers questions about products, shipping, opening hours, and policies instantly.
  • Proactive Sales Triggers: Boost conversions with smart automatic greetings triggered on Exit-Intent, deep scroll (>75%), or visitor inactivity.
  • Interactive Quick Questions: Display click-to-ask chips for your most popular FAQs right at the top of the chat widget.
  • Complete Brand Customization: Choose custom color themes, upload your own Avatar icon, and set custom header banners directly from your WordPress Media Library.
  • Knowledge Base Integration: Easily configure business hours, phone number, and support email that the AI uses dynamically in its replies.
  • Ultra-Lightweight & Mobile-Optimized: Built with pure vanilla JavaScript (no heavy jQuery/React dependencies) and features a native full-screen overlay for mobile devices.
  • Multi-Language Support: Seamlessly understands and communicates in Swedish, English, German, and multiple other languages.
  • 30-Day Free Trial: Test the full experience risk-free with no credit card required.

Secure Proxy Architecture

This plugin connects to a secure central API hosted at https://europe-west3-wp-vertex-chatbot.cloudfunctions.net/generate_demo_chatbot to relay chat messages securely. No private API keys or sensitive credentials are ever exposed in public browser code, ensuring 100% security for your service quota.

External services

This plugin connects to a third-party API to process and relay your website chat conversations securely.

  • Service Name: Axelsson Graphics AI Platform
  • Endpoint URL: https://europe-west3-wp-vertex-chatbot.cloudfunctions.net
  • Why it is used: Relays the website visitor’s chat messages to our secure AI Search platform to generate AI search responses securely, protecting your server credentials from being exposed in public front-end code.
  • Data sent: Relays the raw chat messages typed by the visitor, their selected session ID, and the configured language code. No personal identifying information (PII) is sent unless typed by the user.
  • Terms of Service: Axelsson Graphics Terms of Service
  • Privacy Policy: Axelsson Graphics Privacy Policy
sections.installation:
1. Search for AxG AI Site Assistant directly in your WordPress Admin Dashboard under Plugins > Add New.
  2. Click Install Now and then Activate.
  3. Navigate to Settings > AxG AI in your WordPress sidebar.
  4. Enter your custom Agent ID (received during your 30-day trial onboarding) and customize your styling preferences.
  5. Click Save Settings – your AI assistant is immediately live on your site!
  6. (Optional) Place the shortcode [axgai_chat] anywhere on your site to render the bubble explicitly on a specific page.
sections.faq:
How do I get an Agent ID?

You can start a 30-day free trial directly at axelsson.graphics. Within seconds, your custom-trained bot is generated and your unique Agent ID is delivered to you.

Do I need technical skills or a Google Cloud account?

Not at all. Everything is pre-configured and managed by Axelsson Graphics on Google Cloud Vertex AI. You only need to copy and paste your Agent ID into the plugin settings.

Can I customize the appearance to match my brand?

Yes! You can choose primary accent colors, upload your own brand logo/avatar, set custom header images, and customize suggested quick questions.

Is customer data secure?

Yes. All communication is routed securely via an authenticated proxy, protecting your website and visitors. The AI only uses publicly available information from your website.
